min_standing_note.value: Students taking Master's-level courses MUST hold a completed Bachelor's degree prior to the start of exchange (Bachelor students are barred from MA courses).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Mapped from University-wide scope in Excel partner list.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR C1 required (TOEFL iBT >=92, Academic IELTS >=6.5). Bachelor exchange: proficiency verified by home university. Master's courses: formal test certificate mandatory unless student completed >=2 years of a fully English-taught programme within 2 years prior to exchange (no explicit RHET 1020 exemption stated; AUC English-medium proof aligns with 2-year exemption).

host_language_requirement.value: CEFR C1 Dutch (NT2) required only if taking Dutch-taught courses; optional Dutch NT2 courses available via https://vu.nl/en/education/vu-nt2.
host_language_requirement.notes: NT2 link also on Fact Sheet #page=4.

fall_term_dates.value: Semester 1 (AY 2026-2027): Period 1 31 Aug - 23 Oct 2026; Period 2 26 Oct - 18 Dec 2026; Period 3 4 Jan - 29 Jan 2027 (Academic Opening 31 Aug 2026).
fall_term_dates.notes: Introduction days typically held during last 2 weeks of August per Fact Sheet #page=1.

spring_term_dates.value: Semester 2 (AY 2026-2027): Period 4 1 Feb - 25 Mar 2027; Period 5 30 Mar - 28 May 2027; Period 6 31 May - 25 Jun 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: Orientation held on Friday before Semester 2 starts per Fact Sheet #page=1.

tuition_model.notes: Fact Sheet #page=2 distinguishes exchange agreement nominations from fee-paying 'Semester in Amsterdam' non-degree students, but neither the local PDF nor grounded vu.nl excerpts explicitly state partner-exchange tuition waiver wording.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: VU Amsterdam official student cost-of-living guidance estimates EUR 1,000-2,000/month depending on lifestyle and Amsterdam housing choices (distinct from the ~EUR 1,200/month IND visa proof floor).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate from official EUR 1,000-2,000/month range (midpoint EUR 1,500/mo x 5 = EUR 7,500) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD, collected 2026-11-15 via https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: EUR 250/semester housing handling fee if using VU accommodation service (first paid, first served). Health insurance is mandatory (AON recommended via https://www.students-insurance.eu/educationalinstitutions/en/; EHIC accepted for EU students).

housing_notes.value: Assisted VU accommodation (https://vu.nl/en/education/more-about/exchange-accommodation), limited and NOT guaranteed (first paid, first served; EUR 250/semester handling fee; strict application deadline for housing/visa; full-period rental contracts only).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam applies for the student's visa and/or residence permit on their behalf.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Strict April 15 / Oct 15 application deadlines for visa & housing (#page=2); monthly IND living cost norm ~EUR 1,200/month per https://vu.nl/en/education/more-about/exchange-visa.

course_restrictions_note.value: Psychology and School of Business & Economics (SBE) have limited exchange capacity (majors prioritized); Bachelor students are barred from taking Master's courses.
course_restrictions_note.notes: Completed Bachelor's degree required before exchange start for Master's courses (#page=2).

value: Bachelor's degree copy or completion confirmation statement (if taking Master's courses)
Formal English test proof (if taking Master's courses and not exempt)

international_support_services.value: Arrival & Introduction days, Dutch NT2 courses (https://vu.nl/en/education/vu-nt2), student counselling, and disability support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Semester 1 / Full Year: Nomination deadline 1 April. Semester 2: Nomination deadline 1 October.
nomination_deadlines.notes: Strict student application deadlines for visa/housing on #page=2: 15 April (Semester 1 / AY) and 15 October (Semester 2).
